concept: Planetary diner counter with stargazer portraits
creativeDirection: Use daylight location photography to stage a crisp, physically plausible retro roadside diner terrace where cosmic and performance motifs appear as tangible props, signage, and decor, while the sleeve portraits remain fixed in their original poses within the scene.
scene: A wide 16:9 exterior view of a retro roadside diner forecourt and terrace under clear hard midday sun, shot from slightly below eye level so the counter frontage, terrace tables, and open sky all read cleanly; the setting is real and sunlit, with sharp shadows, chrome details, and a big expanse of blue sky above.

elements.element: A giant glass vacuum tube lies horizontally along the diner counter like a sculptural display case, its metal pins prominent at one end and its amber-tinted glass catching the sun.

The person from reference image 2 stands close to the camera at one side of the terrace in the same front-facing pose with both hands thrust toward the lens, with small star-shaped hanging lights and fingertip star glows suspended around them.
The young man from reference image 3 remains seated on a scooter seen from behind, parked near the curb outside the diner, still wearing the jacket with the circular target emblem.

Abstract blue human silhouettes become painted mural panels on the diner's exterior wall, flattened into graphic signage-like decoration with one dominant pale blue figure and accents of red lettering-inspired striping.

A server's arm in a dark sleeve extends from a service window holding a silver tray carrying a miniature Earth globe, fresh sunflowers and daisies, a white dove perched among them, and an orange butterfly nearby.
A toy-like coin-operated kiddie rocket ride beside the entrance carries the devil-faced figure as a real sculpted amusement object, angled upward with carnival colors and small star decals.
At the far end of the terrace, the performer from reference image 7 is seen from behind with both arms raised toward a tightly packed daytime crowd gathered beyond a low barrier in the forecourt.

coverSummaries.description: A close-up photograph of a glass-and-metal electronic vacuum tube or valve lying horizontally across a pale surface. The left end shows several metal pins, the center is wrapped by a dark cylindrical band, and the right side reveals the transparent glass body with fine internal wire structures. The composition is tightly cropped and softly focused, with a warm amber glow across the whole image.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a close-up vacuum tube with metal pins

coverSummaries.description: A stylized photograph of one person facing the camera with both hands thrust forward toward the lens, creating a dramatic foreshortened effect. Bright glowing star shapes appear attached to or floating around the fingertips and hang on strings throughout the scene like a mobile. The figure has dark clothing and tousled hair, with the face partly obscured by the hands and starbursts. The background is deep blue and purple with a theatrical, high-contrast look.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: outstretched hands surrounded by glowing stars
coverSummaries.people: one person with tousled hair reaching both hands toward the camera

coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white photograph of a young man seen from behind while sitting astride a scooter in a smoky studio-like setting. He wears a jacket with a large circular target-like emblem on the back. The scooter has mirrors, a rear rack, and a visible license plate area, and several small portrait faces appear reflected in the mirrors on the right side. The image is framed by large dark lettering around the edges, but the central scene is monochrome and atmospheric.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a young man on a scooter seen from behind
coverSummaries.people: one young man seated on a scooter, seen from behind

coverSummaries.description: A graphic, poster-like image with a grainy halftone texture showing abstracted blue-toned human figures or silhouettes layered against a dark background. One pale blue figure dominates the center with raised arms or an elongated torso, while other partial figures and shapes surround it. A bold red wordmark stretches across the upper middle, adding strong contrast to the blue and black composition.

A surreal collage set against a star-filled black space background. A hand in a dark suit sleeve holds up a silver serving tray. On the tray sit the Earth, bright flowers including sunflowers and daisies, a white dove, an orange butterfly, and a small golden sun face peeking from the edge. The arrangement resembles a cosmic still life balanced above the hand.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a serving tray holding the Earth, flowers, and a dove

coverSummaries.description: A colorful illustrated space scene featuring a toy-like rocket angled diagonally upward from lower right to upper left. A grinning devilish figure with a painted face rides the rocket, gripping it like a carnival or tin toy. Around it are star shapes, a small firework burst, blue speckles, and swirling sun-like forms in orange and blue against a black background. The overall style is playful and psychedelic.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a devil-faced toy figure riding a rocket

coverSummaries.album: The Best Of Suede Beautiful Ones 1992 2018
coverSummaries.description: A monochrome concert photograph showing a performer from behind at center foreground with both arms raised high toward a densely packed audience. The crowd fills the entire frame, many people clapping, reaching upward, or holding cameras and phones. The performer wears a dark shirt, and the image has a documentary live-show feel with the sea of faces extending to the top edge.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a performer with raised arms facing a large crowd
coverSummaries.people: one performer seen from behind facing a large crowd

prompt: A wide 16:9 exterior view of a retro roadside diner forecourt and terrace under hard midday sun, shot from slightly below eye level with open blue sky above and crisp shadows across the pavement; the primary subject is a giant amber-tinted glass vacuum tube stretched horizontally along the diner counter like a sculptural display, its metal pins clearly visible at the left end and delicate inner wires visible through the glass. The person from reference image 2 stands close to the camera at one side of the terrace in the exact original front-facing pose with both hands thrust toward the lens, hair, styling, expression, and dramatic foreshortening preserved, with small glowing star shapes at the fingertips and additional star ornaments hanging on strings overhead. The young man from reference image 3 is seated on a scooter seen from behind near the curb, pose and framing preserved, jacket with large circular target emblem visible on his back. A mural on the diner's wall translates reference image 4 into bold abstract blue human silhouettes with halftone-like graphic treatment and a red horizontal band. From a service window, only an arm in a dark sleeve extends a silver tray carrying a miniature Earth, sunflowers, daisies, a white dove, an orange butterfly, and a small sun-face ornament from reference image 5. Beside the entrance, reference image 6 becomes a real coin-operated kiddie rocket ride with a devil-faced toy figure gripping the rocket, angled diagonally upward with playful carnival paint and star decals. In the distance, the performer from reference image 7 is seen from behind with both arms raised toward a dense daytime crowd filling the far forecourt. Daylight location photography, clean editorial realism, crisp focus, physically plausible materials, no haze or smoke, no text emphasis. Compose with the vacuum tube and reaching figure leading the eye, scooter and tray as midground anchors, rocket ride and crowd as supporting accents. Palette of sky blue, amber glass, cream, chrome, black, red accents, and sunflower yellow; bright, surreal, energetic mood. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 2 shows one person with tousled hair reaching both hands toward the camera; reference image 3 shows one young man seated on a scooter, seen from behind; reference image 7 shows one performer seen from behind facing a large crowd. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
